meta.sourceOfTruth: Fresh official-site web verification + GitHub pipeline history
meta.updateRule: Fresh lead discovery updates leads.json; real outreach/reply/payment history is preserved separately in sales-engine/pipeline-history.json.
meta.freshQueueRule: Prioritize recently verified higher-ticket service businesses with direct contact paths and no fabricated pipeline activity; never infer outreach, replies, quotes, payments, customers, fulfillment, or revenue from lead refreshes.
meta.workbookSyncMethod: GitHub Actions preserves existing workbook and rebuilds Fresh Leads/Pipeline History from canonical JSON sources.
